title: Scampi Sauce Noodles
description: Spicy gochujang prawns over thin spaghetti — Italian-meets-Korean fusion that delivers huge flavour with minimal calories.
steps: Cook pasta per packet; reserve 50g pasta water; drain.
Defrost prawns in cold water 10–15 min. Mix gochujang, cornstarch and 100g water in a glass. Halve tomatoes; mince garlic.
Fry prawns in oil on medium 60–90 sec per side; remove.
Fry garlic 20 sec; add tomatoes and gochujang sauce; close lid; simmer 4–5 min. Uncover; reduce 2–3 min until creamy. Return prawns; combine.
Add pasta + pasta water; toss 30 sec. Top with basil or parsley.
notes: Originally made with shirataki noodles (10 kcal/100g). Swapped for 80g dry wheat noodles (~280 kcal). Macros adjusted accordingly. Prawns can be swapped for chicken breast.
